evolution_chain.description: Enacted as part of the Government Claims Act (Stats. 1963, Ch. 1681), replacing the common-law sovereign immunity regime following Muskopf v. Corning Hospital District (1961)
Current text with 2016 naming amendment. Core framework architecture unchanged since 1963.

case_law_documented.doctrine: Abolished sovereign immunity, triggering enactment of the Government Claims Act
State tort claim notice requirements preempted for 1983 claims by Supremacy Clause
Government Claims Act is comprehensive statutory scheme, not restoration of sovereign immunity
